notes.title: Figments is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981399/117974fef9193e0b4d3f6b4128c719b11ca3d056.png[/img]
Exciting news - Figments is now live on Kickstarter!

Our campaign will be live for the next 30 days until May 23rd. During this time, backers will have access to Kickstarter-only exclusive rewards and limited-edition items.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/figments/video-game

 
Thank you for joining us on this journey!

The VLL Team
